text: Oct 1 — Huawei launched the Mate90 series; all models use a flagship τ chip and run HarmonyOS 7. Devices feature a second-generation Linglong display with full-color technology and a third-generation Red Maple imaging system, and support the modular Ruiying Z10 camera. Prices: Ma
